name: Park Hyatt Jakarta
positioning: Modern Park Hyatt in the MNC Tower complex in Central Jakarta, minutes from the National Monument (Monas), with guest rooms from the 25th floor upward
best_for: Travelers who want a Central Jakarta base near Monas and the Presidential Palace
Diners who want Cantonese, Japanese and rooftop-bar options under one roof

facts.text: The hotel is in the MNC Tower complex in Central Jakarta.
The hotel is minutes from the National Monument (Monas) and the Presidential Palace.
Guest rooms are designed with Indonesian touches and materials.
Rooms have a deep-soaking marble bath with custom Le Labo products.
Rooms have a desk made of Trembesi wood.
The Diplomat Suite includes a private gym and a kitchen.
Li Lian serves Cantonese cuisine and has six private rooms.
Li Lian Park Lounge is a celebration space for Cantonese dining, suited to Sangjit ceremonies and family celebrations.
KITA Restaurant serves modern Japanese cuisine, including teppanyaki, shabu-shabu, robatayaki and sushi, from an open kitchen.
Dining Room, on level 22, serves buffets of Indonesian specialties alongside regional Italian cuisine.
Atelier 23 is a culinary and patisserie space combining French classics with Southeast Asian signatures.
The Spa, on the 35th floor, draws on Indonesian healing traditions with aesthetic treatments and traditional body therapies.

highlights.text: Li Lian's signature Peking duck is slow-roasted over rambutan wood and carved at the table.
KITA Bar is a rooftop bar on level 36 with outdoor and indoor spaces and sunset views of the National Monument (Monas).
The Magic Table is a dining experience led by Thommy Ten and Amelie van Tass, known as The Clairvoyants, using 3D projection mapping on each table.
All guest rooms are from the 25th floor upward, with views of Jakarta.
The outdoor pool is on the 35th floor next to the fitness center, with a sun deck and city views.

considerations.text: Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK) is 30 kilometers from the hotel; Halim Perdanakusuma International Airport (HLP) is 18 kilometers away.
The hotel is a smoke-free property.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
